description: This file implements the driver and file system handling for an MMC/SD card interface, including initialization, mounting, unmounting, logging, directory listing, and error management. It interacts with hardware and USB subsystems, utilizing a FAT filesystem.

classes.name: MMCDriver
classes.description: Represents the MMC hardware driver, managing card state and interactions.

methods.name: printError
methods.description: Logs FAT filesystem errors with a given message.

methods.name: listDirectory
methods.description: Lists files in a specified directory, filtering based on log prefix.

methods.name: createLogFile
methods.description: Creates and opens a new log file with a timestamped filename.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a line of text to the current log file.

methods.name: MMCmount
methods.description: Handles mounting the SD card filesystem and initializing USB if enabled.

methods.name: MMCumount
methods.description: Unmounts the SD card filesystem and handles cleanup.
